breaking_news.headline: They attended Trump's meme coin dinner.  It didn't go well
breaking_news.summary: Trump's meme coin dinners have sparked intense controversy. These two guests attended his latest on Sunday — and agreed to provide NPR inside access.

breaking_news.headline: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
breaking_news.summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.

breaking_news.headline: What should it cost to insure a home in wildfire country?
breaking_news.summary: Some California homeowners have spent thousands making their homes safer from wildfires. Yet all that work has barely made a dent in their insurance bills. Should they be getting a bigger break?

breaking_news.headline: Unpacking President Trump's financial stake in Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Dan Alexander, a senior editor at Forbes and author of a book about President Trump's businesses, about the president's holdings in Nvidia given recent news.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia's board under fire for handling of CEO's alleged affairs
breaking_news.summary: Even as Jensen Huang has returned to work, Nvidia's board is facing criticism over how it handled the crisis brought on by the CEO's alleged affairs.

breaking_news.headline: In a time of rising costs, one Thanksgiving commodity is cheaper: cannabis
breaking_news.summary: Steep discounts for "Green Wednesday," one of the highest-selling days for cannabis, help customers keep costs down. But experts say retailers are feeling the pinch.

breaking_news.headline: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
breaking_news.summary: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.

breaking_news.headline: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
breaking_news.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

breaking_news.headline: Protesters call on Israel to free Palestinian student held without charge
breaking_news.summary: Mahdi Tunsi, 26, was taken from his university dormitory earlier this month and has since been held without charge.

breaking_news.headline: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
breaking_news.summary: Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, was killed with his wife and two teenage daughters, doctors say.

breaking_news.headline: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
breaking_news.summary: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

breaking_news.headline: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
breaking_news.summary: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

breaking_news.headline: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
breaking_news.summary: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.

breaking_news.headline: Energy bills will soar - here's how you can ease the pain
breaking_news.summary: Household energy bills are about to increase but there are ways to keep a lid on your expenditure.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
breaking_news.summary: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.

breaking_news.headline: Why tiny cars are taking off across Europe
breaking_news.summary: Once seen as a car for elderly, rural people, tiny cars are being embraced by a younger demographic.

breaking_news.headline: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
breaking_news.summary: A household using a typical amount of energy would see its annual bill rise from £1,723 to £2,166 if this level was sustained for a year.

breaking_news.headline: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
breaking_news.summary: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

breaking_news.headline: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
breaking_news.summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.
